alkylation_reagent.evidence: The in-gel trypsin digestion was carried out under reducing conditions afforded by DTT, and alkylation was achieved using iodoacetic acid.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Peptides were analyzed using a Thermo Scientific Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid mass spectrometer operating at 120,000 resolution (FWHM in MS1, 15,000 for MS/MS) with higher-energy collisional dissociation sequencing of all peptides with a charge of 2+ or greater.
